description: Eleven conversion overlays for short-form ads, UGC and creator videos, with presets per platform: CTA pill, follow tap prompt, story sticker tag, LIVE badge with viewer count, notification drop, review proof card, story caption bar, photo wall loop, follower counter and goal bar, comment callout (reply-to-comment) and subscribe-and-bell nudge. Presets use one universal 9:16 safe box built from TikTok, Meta Reels, YouTube Shorts and Snap specs, CTA timing from creator analysts (ask after value, never in the intro), native number formats, contrast and motion tokens, plus the FTC rules: reviews, comments and counts come from real data only and paid content is disclosed. Use when an ad or creator video needs a call to action, a subscribe or follow ask, a review or comment on screen, a LIVE badge or a counter. NOT for fake reviews, fake follower counts or copying a platform's logo.
